gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the UGREEN NAS UPS US3000 (120 W DC, 12,000 mAh / 43.2 Wh) plugs into a NASync DXP2800 by USB and is detected by UGOS Pro. UGOS Pro then shuts the NAS down cleanly a few minutes into an outage, and the UPS powers it back on when mains power returns, so the NAS and UPS have to be bought as a matched pair from UGREEN's own line.
standout_why: I compared against the pages in ChatGPT's results that I could open. terabytewise.com/best-nas-for-plex-transcoding (updated 2026-11-11) already lists UGREEN's US2000 ($69.99) and US3000 ($109.99), NAS+UPS bundles such as DXP2800 + US2000 at $460.22, and the US2000 line 'Only Compatible for UGREEN NAS DH2300, DH4300 Plus, DXP2800, DXP2800 GT'. It does not say how the UPS talks to the NAS (USB), that UGOS Pro detects it and shuts down cleanly, or what happens when power returns. qnap.com/en/solution/plex-best-nas does not mention a UPS, drive compatibility, a switch or backup. The Plex support pages cover only transcoding, CPUs and NAS limits. terabytewise already has part of the UPS story, so this scores 1, not 2.
kit_items: NAS: UGREEN NASync DXP2800 (2-bay, Intel N100, 2.5GbE). It handles ChatGPT's 'budget 2-bay Plex' case, and actualidadgadget tested it with the US3000.

UPS: UGREEN NAS UPS US3000 (120 W DC, 43.2 Wh). It links to the NAS by USB so UGOS Pro can shut down cleanly, and it restarts the NAS when power returns. The cheaper US2000 (72 W) also fits the DXP2800 according to its own product title as quoted on terabytewise.
Drives: 2× NAS-rated 3.5-inch HDDs, mirrored (ChatGPT's own suggestion was 2 × 8 TB). The search of nas.ugreen.com returned no hard drives, so drives can't go in the same cart.
Step-up option: UGREEN NASync DXP4800 Plus (4-bay) + US3000. I could not open a UGREEN or manual page that confirms this pairing (see unsourced).

carts.store: UGREEN NAS store (nas.ugreen.com). Note: the approved cj:ugreen program lists us.ugreen.com, and that store's search returned no NAS or NAS-UPS products. Check that the CJ link covers nas.ugreen.com before using this cart.

findings.value: DC power plus a USB data cable. UGOS Pro detects the UPS 'immediately' over USB. In an outage the NAS enters safe mode and shuts down cleanly after a few minutes. When power returns, the UPS powers the NAS back on without anyone touching it.
